attributes.description: towering, jagged mountain peak with rugged, snow-laden slopes catching the golden glow of the sun on one side while the other remains in cool, twilight shadow
gently flowing, snow-dusted river or fjord with smooth, silky water texture from a long exposure, reflecting the soft, warm light of the setting sun
rocky, snow-covered shoreline with weathered wood and muted earthy tones
cluster of traditional, bright red wooden fishing cabins with white-trimmed windows and black rooflines, perched on stilts over the fjord, arranged along a rocky, snow-covered shoreline
snow-dusted river, snowy surfaces, and snow-laden mountain slopes
sky transitioning from soft lavender and rose-pink near the horizon to a deeper, muted purple higher up
